findings.message: Job `test` pipes the test command into another tool without `set -o pipefail`.
findings.why: In a shell pipeline only the last command's exit code counts — a failing test run is masked by the downstream tool succeeding.
findings.fix: Add `shell: bash` with `set -o pipefail`, or split into two steps so the test command's exit code is preserved.

findings.message: Job `deploy-smoke` sequences commands with `; ` after the test command — the test result does not fail the step.
findings.why: With `;` sequencing the step's exit status comes from the last command only, so failed tests still yield a green checkmark.
findings.fix: Chain with `&&` instead of `;` so a test failure fails the step.

findings.message: Job `deploy-smoke` runs tests but its `if:` condition skips it on pull requests.
findings.why: If this job is a required check, PRs can satisfy it while zero tests executed — the green checkmark verifies nothing.
findings.fix: Remove the skip-on-PR condition, or split into a dedicated PR test job and require THAT one in branch protection.

findings.message: Job `security-scan` runs a verification gate under `continue-on-error: true`.
findings.why: This job can fail every day and CI will still show green. The checkmark on this workflow cannot be trusted.
findings.fix: Remove continue-on-error, or scope it to individual non-blocking steps only.

findings.message: UI-interacting spec file contains no accessibility assertions.
findings.why: Suites that drive the UI but never assert accessibility let WCAG regressions through every PR; catching them at the point of interaction is far cheaper than a retrofit audit.
findings.fix: Add `@axe-core/playwright` with `expect(await new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze()).toHaveNoViolations()` on key pages, or snapshot aria snapshots.

findings.why: Magic-default timeouts make failures opaque (was it slow, or broken?) and never encode the product's actual performance budget.
findings.fix: Pass `{ timeout: <budget-ms> }` matching your performance SLO, or set actionTimeout/navigationTimeout deliberately in config.

findings.message: CSS/XPath string selector where a normalized locator is expected.
findings.why: String CSS/XPath selectors couple the test to markup the user never sees — they break on any refactor and can silently select the wrong element after a redesign.
findings.fix: Normalize to Playwright's user-facing getters: getByRole('button', { name: '…' }), getByLabel('…'), getByTestId('…'), or getByText('…') — they survive markup refactors and match what a user actually perceives.

findings.why: Structural selectors break on any DOM refactor and fail without telling you which behavior regressed.
findings.fix: Prefer role-based locators: getByRole(), getByText(), getByLabel().

findings.why: Fixed waits either wait too long (slow suite) or too little (flaky on slow machines). They encode hope, not synchronization.
findings.fix: Replace with a web-first assertion (`await expect(locator).toBeVisible()`) or `locator.waitFor()`.

findings.fix: Fix and re-enable the test, or delete it with a tracked issue reference.

findings.why: Specs pointing at absolute URLs break when environments change and can hit production by accident.
findings.fix: Use relative paths with baseURL from playwright.config, or an env variable.

findings.why: Network idle is unreliable — background requests, analytics, and websockets make it never fire or fire randomly.
findings.fix: Wait for a specific element or response: `page.waitForResponse()` or `expect(locator).toBeVisible()`.

findings.why: A test that fails once and passes on retry is exactly the case you'll need evidence for later — with no trace, the flake is uninvestigable.
findings.fix: Add `use: { trace: 'on-first-retry' }` to the config.

findings.message: playwright.config captures neither screenshots nor video on failure.
findings.why: Once the CI runner is gone, a failed UI test is just a stack trace. Screenshots/video on failure turn 'cannot reproduce' into a five-second diagnosis.
findings.fix: Add `use: { screenshot: 'only-on-failure', video: 'retain-on-failure' }` to the config.

findings.message: retries: undefined with no visible flake-triage loop.
findings.why: Retries convert intermittent failures into silent passes. Without a forensics/triage step consuming retry data, flaky tests pass forever and real regressions hide behind lucky reruns.
findings.fix: Keep retries <= 2 and feed retry outcomes into `mjolnir forensics`/`triage`, or add a reporter so flaky passes are reviewed.

findings.why: Without an assertion the test can only fail by crashing — it cannot detect behavioral regressions.
findings.fix: Add an `assert` on the expected outcome, or remove the test.

findings.why: Fixed sleeps make tests slow and flaky — they guess at timing instead of waiting for state.
findings.fix: Wait for an explicit condition (polling helper, pytest-timeout wait_until, or event).

agenticProfile.note: Static provenance markers only (generated-file headers, Playwright codegen default titles). Absence of a marker does not prove human authorship; healed and MCP-edited files without markers are indistinguishable from hand-written ones. Provenance never changes scoring or evidence — authorship is metadata, not trust.
